[[Cibao FC]] | continentalcup2 = [[CFU Club Shield]] | continentalcup2 qualifiers = [[Atlético Pantoja]] *[[Delfines del Este FC|Delfines del Este]]Berth was later granted to Delfines del Este due to Pantoja's Licence pause announcement | matches = 141between August 2025 and May 2026. | total goals = | league topscorer = [[Daniel Jamesley]] (25) | biggest home win = | biggest away win = | highest scoring = | prevseason = [[2025 liga dominicana de futbol|2025]] | nextseason = [[2026-27 liga dominicana de fútbol|2026-27]] | updated = }} The 2025–26 season of the '''[[Liga Dominicana de Fútbol]]''' was the 11th season of [[Association football]] in the [[Dominican Republic]]. On 4 August 2025, The [[Liga Dominicana de Fútbol|LDF]] Board of Directors announced the 2025-26 tournament would be dedicated to the late [[José Rafael Abinader]], who founded [[O&M FC]] and helped promote university and professional football.{{cite web |title=The 2025-2026 LDF tournament will be dedicated to the memory of José Rafael Abinader |url=https://www.ligadominicanadefutbol.com/2025/08/04/torneo-de-la-ldf-2025-2026-sera-dedicado-a-la-memoria-de-jose-rafael-abinader/ |website=Liga Dominicana de fútbol |publisher=Prensa LDF}} On 8 August 2025, the season officially kicked-off with Matchday 1 featuring the Country's ''Clasico del Norte'',Also known as ''Clasico Cibaeño'' a rivalry between then defending champions of both the [[2024 Liga Dominicana de Fútbol|2024 Liga Dominicana de Fútbol season]] & [[2025 Copa Dominicana de Fútbol]] [[Cibao FC]] and [[Moca FC]].{{cite web |title=La LDF arranca este viernes en Santiago – Liga Dominicana de Fútbol |url=https://www.ligadominicanadefutbol.com/2025/08/06/la-ldf-arranca-este-viernes-en-santiago/ |website=www.ligadominicanadefutbol.com |access-date=3 June 2026 |language=es-AR}} == Competition system == The [[Liga Dominicana de Fútbol]] tournament consists of three parts: * '' Regular Season: ''The competition format will have a regular three-round phase, with a minimum of eighteen matches for all clubs. The six best qualifiers from the regular phase go to the Liguilla, in a round-robin format. From there, the best four teams advance to the semifinals, with their winners going to the grand final of the LDF 2026, all of which have 2-legged matches. The order of classification of the teams will be determined in a general calculation table, as follows: * 1) Higher number of points; * 2) Greater goal difference in favor; in case of equality; * 3) Higher number of goals scored; in case of equality; * 4) Highest number of away goals scored; in case of equality; * 5) Fewest red cards received; in case of equality; * 6) Fewest yellow cards received; in case of equality; * 7) Draw. * ''Liguilla:'' The six teams classified from the regular season will play a system of all against all. Each team will play a total of five matches in their own field and in the opposite field, making a total of three rounds. The top four teams at the end of the League will advance to the Play-offs. The ranking order will be the same as for the Regular Season. * '' Play-offs: '' An elimination system will be played, the first place in the Liguilla will face the fourth place and the second place will face the third. Both keys will be played in two games and the winners will advance to the Grand Final, which will also be played in two games. == Participating Clubs == A total of 10 clubs participated for the 2025–26 season. However, due to FIFA's decision to sanction [[CA San Cristóbal|Atletico San Cristobal]] and have them relegated to the [[Liga Dominicana de Futbol Expansion|Liga Dominicana de Fútbol Expansion]], The LDF revamped the system to align to a league with 9 clubs.
